ambiguous_question: Show each stadium with its number of concerts.
clarification_target: Whether stadiums with no recorded concerts should also be included with a count of zero.
user_resolution: Include every stadium, including stadiums with no recorded concerts, using zero for their count.
resolved_question: Show every stadium with its number of recorded concerts, including stadiums with no concerts with a count of zero.
gold_sql: SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) FROM stadium AS s LEFT JOIN concert AS c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID

ambiguous_question: What is the average number of concert participations per singer?
clarification_target: Whether singers with no recorded participation should be included in the average with zero participations.
user_resolution: Include all singers in the average, treating singers with no recorded participation as zero.
resolved_question: What is the average number of concert participations per singer across all singers, counting singers with no participation as zero?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(concert_count) FROM (SELECT s.Singer_ID, COUNT(sic.concert_ID) AS concert_count FROM singer AS s LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID GROUP BY s.Singer_ID)

ambiguous_question: Who is the youngest singer in the concert data?
clarification_target: Whether the search should cover every singer in the singer table or only singers with recorded concert participation.
user_resolution: Consider only singers with at least one recorded concert participation.
resolved_question: Who is the youngest singer among singers with at least one recorded concert participation?
gold_sql: SELECT s.Name, s.Age FROM singer AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert AS sic WHERE sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID) AND s.Age = (SELECT MIN(s2.Age) FROM singer AS s2 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert AS sic2 WHERE sic2.Singer_ID = s2.Singer_ID))

ambiguous_question: What is the average capacity of stadiums in the concert data?
clarification_target: Whether the average should include every stadium or only stadiums with at least one recorded concert.

resolved_question: What is the average capacity of stadiums that have hosted at least one recorded concert, counting each stadium once?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(s.Capacity) FROM stadium AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concert AS c WHERE c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID)

ambiguous_question: What is the average age of singers in the concert participation records?
clarification_target: Whether each distinct singer should contribute once or repeated concert participations should give a singer more weight.

resolved_question: What is the average age of distinct singers with at least one concert participation, counting each singer once?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(s.Age) FROM singer AS s WHERE s.Singer_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert AS sic)

ambiguous_question: What is the average song release year for singers represented in concert participation records?

resolved_question: What is the average song release year across distinct singers with at least one concert participation, counting each singer once?

ambiguous_question: What is the average age of male and female singers?
